events.description:
Events to deliver: message.received (incoming client messages only),
conversation.handoff_requested, deal.created, deal.moved, deal.updated, deal.deleted.

url.description: URL is a public https URL; it cannot be changed later.

description: Every delivery is a POST with X-ReplyBuddy-Event, X-ReplyBuddy-Delivery and X-ReplyBuddy-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with the secret>. Body: {id, type, api_version, created_at, agent_id, data}; dedupe on id. data by type: message.received {conversation_id, message}; conversation.handoff_requested {conversation_id, reason}; deal.created and deal.updated {deal}; deal.moved {deal, from_stage_id, moved_by}; deal.deleted {deal_id}; webhook.test {endpoint_id}. Answer 2xx within 10 seconds: a timeout, a 3xx (redirects are not followed) or any other status is a failure. A failed delivery gets 8 attempts over about 28 hours; an endpoint whose deliveries keep failing is disabled. The URL cannot be changed later.

consecutive_failures.description: ConsecutiveFailures counts failed attempts since the last success.

description.description: Description is a free-form note, up to 200 characters.

disabled_reason.description: DisabledReason is set when deliveries kept failing and the endpoint was switched off.

secret.description: Secret signs every delivery (X-ReplyBuddy-Signature); returned only on create and rotate.
